title: Epp base change for one trait
statement: Let $p$ be a prime number. Let $W_0$ be a complete discrete valuation ring of mixed characteristic $(0,p)$, meaning characteristic zero for the fraction field and characteristic $p$ for the residue field, with perfect residue field $k_0$ (Frobenius $x\mapsto x^p$ is surjective) and fraction field $K_0$ [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring, def-weil-field]. Let $T$ be an excellent discrete valuation ring [def-exc-excellent-ring] with an injective local map $W_0\hookrightarrow T$, fraction field $F$, and residue field $\kappa$; local means that the inverse image of the maximal ideal of $T$ is the maximal ideal of $W_0$. Assume every element of $\bigcap_{n\geq0}\kappa^{p^n}$, where $\kappa^{p^n}=\{x^{p^n}:x\in\kappa\}$, is algebraic over the induced copy of $k_0$. A finite extension of $W_0$ is a complete discrete valuation ring $W'$ with an injective local map $W_0\hookrightarrow W'$ making $W'$ a finite $W_0$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]; its fraction field $K'$ is a finite field extension of $K_0$ [def-pc-field-extension]. For such $W'$, the $K'$-algebra $F\otimes_{K_0}K'$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] is a finite product of fields, and a field factor of it is its quotient $E$ by a maximal ideal. For a field factor $E$ let $B_E\subset E$ be the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] in $E$ of the image of the composite $T\otimes_{W_0}W'\to F\otimes_{K_0}K'\to E$. Call $W'$ good for $T$ if, for a uniformizer $\pi'$ of $W'$ and every field factor $E$, the ring $B_E/\pi'B_E$ is reduced, i.e. has no nonzero nilpotent element; this does not depend on the choice of $\pi'$. Then: (1) there exists a finite extension $W'$ of $W_0$ that is good for $T$; (2) for every finite extension $W'$ of $W_0$ the ring $T\otimes_{W_0}W'$ is reduced; (3) if $W'$ is good for $T$ and $W''$ is a finite extension of $W_0$ equipped with a local $W_0$-algebra map $W'\to W''$, then $W''$ is good for $T$.
